messages:
marie (docs): Quick heads-up: we're announcing a 90-day deprecation for the Python compatibility shim next Tue. Preview migration guide and CLI tool are live in staging: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/sdk-py-migrate

alek (sdk): Context: the shim normalizes older call shapes (str vs list) and implicit kwargs. Removing it cleans up surface and lets us simplify telemetry and type checks. CLI will scan and optionally autofix common patterns.

jamal (devex): Scheduling migration office hours: Tues 10am and Thurs 4pm PST for the next 6 weeks. Will record. RSVP link will go to #general and calendar invite.

marie (docs): Docs checklist for reviewers: update all in-page code samples, add a short migration FAQ, include the opt-out telemetry snippet, and ensure examples use explicit parameter names. I added a staging artifact with flagged pages.

samira (legal): Please ensure CLI telemetry is opt-in by default for external builds. Internal infra can log anonymized hashes but public-facing docs must show REDWOOD_MIGRATE_TELEMETRY=0 to disable. Also add a short privacy blurb for customer-facing announcement.

alek (sdk): Note on breaking patterns: old `client.generate(prompt=some)` where prompt was a list or str — new API requires `prompts=[...]` or `prompt="..."`. Also `client.chat(..., role="user")` implicit role mapping is removed. We'll ship adapter helpers like `compat.promote_prompt()` to soften transition.

elliot (support): Heads-up from support: a couple of mid-market customers asked for extra runway. Can we offer a Dedicated tenant grace period?

devon (product): Yes — we can allow a Dedicated extension per request. Default public timeline stays 90 days, but add a request form. Add to the announcement copy.

marie (docs): CI note: staging build link in convo. deploy-bot posted green. If reviewers approve, we'll publish the deprecation page and customer email template next Tue.

alek (sdk): I'll land a small snippet PR with before/after diffs for the five most common break types and include automated codemod examples.

jamal (devex): I'll run the CLI against the docs repo and open PRs for any sample fixes we can autoapply. Will include manual review for complex examples.

samira (legal): Approved privacy copy. Also confirm we don't send full source files in telemetry — only counts, anonymized stack fingerprints, and heuristic tags.

marie (docs): Final ask: folks, skim the preview guide and flag any docs pages that still rely on shim behavior. I flagged ~12 pages already and attached the list to the staging artifact. Will merge once reviewers ack.

alek (sdk): ack — starting the snippet PR now.

elliot (support): noted — I'll prepare a canned response for support and SRE runbook entries for any rollover issues.

marie (docs): Thanks everyone. Plan: publish announcement, open migration PRs for docs samples, host office hours, and monitor issues.
